judgments.candidate_name: Python 3.3.5 bytes literals and byte sequences
judgments.candidate_claim: Python's b-prefixed literals combine readable ASCII with escaped arbitrary byte values while keeping binary data distinct from Unicode text.

gold_matches.rationale: Original rank 1 explicitly uses Python 3.3.5 b-prefixed byte-string syntax with readable ASCII and escaped arbitrary bytes, the named Python byte-string literal precedent in gold Alternatives.

judgments.match_rationale: The candidate identifies Python b-prefixed byte strings and the exact binary/Unicode distinction in the external gold item. No other literal prefix/suffix or macro policy is inferred.

H.constraint: 전체 입력이 Unicode라는 가정 없이 원시 바이트 의미를 보존할 것
H.reason: The versioned bytes-literal grammar preserves ASCII and escaped arbitrary byte values separately from Unicode str.

H.constraint: 개별 바이트와 바이트열을 모두 다룰 것
H.reason: Companion versioned documentation verifies integer elements in 0..255 and sequence-valued slices; the original explicitly distinguishes a one-byte sequence from its integer element.

judgments.transfer_mapping: Map b-prefixed readable ASCII/byte escapes to binary sequence literals and integer indexing to individual byte values, with explicit encoding for text conversion. Preserve the original rejection of direct non-ASCII literal characters and the distinction between a byte and a one-element sequence.
judgments.H_assessment_scope: reference_design: separate readable binary literals and integer byte elements
judgments.label: CONDITIONAL_TRANSFER
judgments.remaining_check: No decisive documentary uncertainty within the original narrow reference scope; implementation transfer and runtime utility were not observed.

judgments.match_rationale: Racket is not Python’s external entity; generic numeric byte access does not explicitly select numeric literal patterns as the target design.

H.constraint: 전체 입력이 Unicode라는 가정 없이 원시 바이트 의미를 보존할 것

judgments.match_rationale: The original does not cast runtime bytes to Rust Unicode characters or select the gold a/u8 spelling alternatives. A foreign 8-bit char type is not the same cast mechanism.

H.constraint: 전체 입력이 Unicode라는 가정 없이 원시 바이트 의미를 보존할 것
H.reason: 8-bit character/string storage covers raw byte values without requiring globally valid UTF-8; the original deliberately separates this notation from Rust’s Unicode types.

H.reason: The source provides single-quoted 8-bit values and double-quoted sequences using consistent escapes.

judgments.transfer_mapping: Map single/double quoted 8-bit forms to separate Rust byte and byte-sequence types, not to existing Unicode char/str. Preserve the original upper-byte Latin-1 semantic difference and transfer byte-valued notation only.

judgments.candidate_name: Go strings as arbitrary byte sequences
judgments.candidate_claim: Go demonstrates readable string literals with byte escapes and byte indexing even when the resulting sequence is invalid UTF-8.
judgments.match_rationale: The original proposes raw-byte storage/inspection and warns about UTF-8 source text/rune iteration; it does not choose UTF-8 encoding of all literal code points as the target byte-literal policy. No structural default is inferred from that caveat.

H.constraint: 전체 입력이 Unicode라는 가정 없이 원시 바이트 의미를 보존할 것
H.reason: Original use selects byte escapes and indexing on strings that may contain invalid UTF-8; it explicitly excludes rune-decoding range iteration from raw-byte interpretation.

H.constraint: 개별 바이트와 바이트열을 모두 다룰 것
H.reason: Strings provide sequences and indexing yields individual bytes, both explicitly documented.

judgments.transfer_mapping: Map known literal ASCII/byte escapes to raw sequence storage and index operations to byte values. Keep the original distinction from unescaped source Unicode and range-based rune decoding; those text operations cannot stand in for raw-byte inspection.
judgments.H_assessment_scope: reference_design: arbitrary-byte sequences with byte-level indexing
judgments.label: CONDITIONAL_TRANSFER

judgments.candidate_claim: ByteString.Char8 supplies pack, singleton, and overloaded string literals as a library route from readable notation to byte storage.
judgments.match_rationale: Overloaded string literals and singleton do not constitute the gold pattern-capable byte-macro design; no pattern expansion is stated.

H.constraint: 전체 입력이 Unicode라는 가정 없이 원시 바이트 의미를 보존할 것
H.reason: Char8 accepts Char inputs and truncates them to eight bits. The original warns of information loss but supplies no range restriction or validation policy ensuring every proposed source value has byte meaning.

H.constraint: 개별 바이트와 바이트열을 모두 다룰 것
H.reason: The original specifically proposes singleton/pack and single-byte sequences; it does not establish a corresponding individual raw-byte value form distinct from a Char or one-element sequence.

judgments.transfer_mapping: Map library pack/singleton or overloaded literals to byte storage while keeping the original truncation warning. Neither a new range validator nor a scalar-byte literal conversion is silently added.
judgments.H_assessment_scope: reference_design: Char-based library construction of byte sequences
judgments.label: INSUFFICIENT
judgments.remaining_check: Specify whether inputs are restricted to 0..255 and identify the individual-byte value operation. Verified range-safe scalar/sequence uses could pass; unrestricted larger Char inputs demonstrably lose information and would fail H1.
